user.title: Name your assistant
user.description: Everything else is optional and can be changed later.

data_description.assistant_name: Used when it speaks, on the dashboard, and in the instructions given to your language model.

hubbubb.name: Hubbubb (optional)
hubbubb.description: Connect your Hubbubb organisation so the assistant can answer questions about your records and correspondence. Create a client ID and secret in Hubbubb, then paste them here.

companion.name: Companion (optional)
companion.description: Only if you run the companion daemon on a computer with a coding agent on it. Without one, everything works except the build screen.

error.hubbubb_incomplete: Hubbubb needs all three: endpoint, client ID and client secret.
error.hubbubb_auth: Hubbubb refused those credentials, or could not be reached.

abort.already_configured: Hubbubb Home is already set up.

data_description.prompt: Given to your language model alongside Home Assistant's own instructions. {name} is replaced with the assistant's name.
data_description.install_sentences: Turn this off if your setup already answers phrases like "remember that…" with its own intents — two files claiming one phrase means one of them loses, silently. Takes effect after a restart.

overnight.name: Overnight sweep
overnight.description: Once a night, look for things that have gone offline or stopped changing. It only ever reports.

data.ignore: Ignore these (one entity ID or pattern per line)

briefing.name: Morning briefing
briefing.description: Weather, today's calendar, and what the sweep found - spoken through a voice satellite.

data_description.briefing_target: Also where finished timers announce themselves.

error.hubbubb_incomplete: Hubbubb needs all three: endpoint, client ID and client secret.
error.hubbubb_auth: Hubbubb refused those credentials, or could not be reached.

remember.name: Remember
remember.description: Store one durable fact about the household.

forget.name: Forget
forget.description: Delete the memory that best matches a description.

name.name: Name
name.description: The timer's name; the next to finish if left blank.

timer_add.name: Add time
timer_add.description: Add or remove time on a running countdown.

ask_hubbubb.name: Ask Hubbubb
ask_hubbubb.description: Put a plain-English request to Hubbubb.

run_sweep.name: Sweep the house
run_sweep.description: Run the overnight checks now. Changes nothing.

speak_briefing.name: Speak the briefing
speak_briefing.description: Say the morning briefing now, and return its text.

agent_prompt_direct.name: Prompt the agent
agent_prompt_direct.description: Send text straight to the current session.

agent_upload.name: Upload to the agent
agent_upload.description: Send a file to the session.

agent_key.name: Send a key
agent_key.description: Press a key in the session.
